title: Expense Sheet Document Automation
summary: A document automation workflow that extracts details from expense sheets using AI and OCR.
overview: A document automation project at JHS & Associates LLP in which details are extracted from expense sheets using AI and OCR.
problem: Expense sheets arrive as documents, and keying their details into a system by hand is slow and error-prone. OCR and AI-based extraction can read the sheets and pull out the details automatically.
approach: Developed a document automation workflow that extracts details from expense sheets using AI and OCR.

architecture.label: OCR and AI extraction
architecture.detail: OCR reads the expense sheets and AI is used to extract the details from them.

architecture.label: Specific models, OCR engine, fields extracted, validation and output format
architecture.detail: Not specified. Confidential employer information is not published.

workflow.step: Expense sheets are read with OCR.
AI extracts the details from the sheets.
